stem:
A metal wheel consists of an axle A, eight spokes and a rim, as shown in Fig. 1.1.

[[fig:f1]]

Point X is on the rim at the end of one of the spokes.

The rim has a radius of 0.85 m.
The wheel is rotating clockwise with an angular speed of 140 rad s⁻¹.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.lead: There is a uniform magnetic field of flux density 0.18 T into the plane of the page.
parts.text: State Lenz’s law of electromagnetic induction.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Show that the time taken for point X to complete one revolution is 45 ms.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Calculate the magnetic flux cut by spoke AX during one revolution of the wheel. Give a unit with your answer.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Determine the magnitude of the electromotive force (e.m.f.) induced across spoke AX.

parts.label: (b)(v)
parts.text: Use Lenz’s law to explain whether the potential is higher at end A or end X of the spoke.

figures.caption: Fig. 1.1
figures.alt: A wheel with eight spokes and labels identifying the axle A, one spoke, the rim, and point X at the end of a horizontal spoke.
